headline: Cell paper introduces an open aging-biology benchmark and compact specialist language models
summary: A September 17 Cell paper introduces LongevityBench, an open benchmark of 17 tasks across five aging-biology data domains, and five specialized language models with 0.6B–9B parameters. The authors report evaluating 18 frontier AI systems and say the compact Longevity-LLMs matched or exceeded larger systems on the benchmark; they identify omics-based age prediction as the hardest task. The publisher abstract and author-maintained benchmark page support the paper’s scope and reported comparison, but the full paper and supplementary methods were not accessible in this activation. Treat performance as claimed, not independently established.
